title: sneed-and-feed/lean-theorems-1
abstract: A complete, machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of Bárány's Colorful Carathéodory Theorem (1982), Bárány's First Selection Lemma (1982), the 1D Centerpoint Theorem, and geometric deductions from first principles. Proves that for any d + 1 sets of points S_0, ..., S_d in R^d whose convex hulls all contain a common target point p, there exists a colorful transversal f (selecting f(i) in S_i for each color class i) whose convex hull conv({f(0), ..., f(d)}) contains p. Formulated over arbitrary dimension d, with specializations to the origin and low dimensions (d = 0, 1, 2), a formal deduction of the classical Carathéodory theorem bound, the 1D Centerpoint Theorem (median contains >= floor((n+1)/2) = ceil(n/2) points in each half-line), Bárány's 1982 First Selection Lemma (>= (|P|/2)(|P|-|P|/2) pairs containing the centerpoint), and the 1D Colorful Selection Lemma (at least one colorful pair covering p). To the maintainers' knowledge, the theorem was not found in an exact declaration name, docstring, and type signature search of the pinned Mathlib revision (Mathlib v4.34.0-rc1).
